definitionZh: 边框-右上方-射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半主轴和半小轴半径)来绕过一个元素的上方右角.
sourceDefinition: The border-top-right-radius CSS property rounds the top-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The border-top-right-radius CSS property rounds the top-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
